title: Phase to motion
note: Phase change between two passes gives motion along the line of sight, positive toward the satellite.

title: One colour cycle
note: Each full colour cycle is half a wavelength of motion.

title: Wavelength
note: NISAR L-band: f = 1.257 GHz, so λ ≈ 23.8 cm.

title: Wetland double bounce
note: Water, then stem, then back: the two-way path changes by 2Δh·cosθ, half of which is the equivalent line-of-sight motion (θ ≈ 37°).

title: Volcanic source (Mogi)
note: Uplift above a pressurised source at depth d (ν = 0.25).

title: Building settlement (creep)
note: Fast at first, slowing as the sand layers compact.

title: Ice-shelf tidal flexure
note: Elastic beam bending across the grounding line.

title: Phase noise from coherence
note: Cramér–Rao bound for L looks at coherence γ.
